description: Meezan Bank Limited describes itself as Pakistan's first and largest Islamic bank, and as one of the fastest growing financial institutions in the country's banking sector. It offers Shariah-compliant banking built on Islamic financing modes rather than lending - Diminishing Musharakah for home finance, Ijarah for car finance, and Mudarabah-based savings accounts.
headOffice: Meezan House, C-25 Estate Avenue, SITE, Karachi, Pakistan

products.name: Meezan Bachat Account
products.summary: A savings account providing halal monthly profit for low and middle income customers, with the convenience and services of a regular savings account.

products.name: Meezan Car Ijarah
products.summary: The bank's car financing product, described by Meezan as Pakistan's first interest-free car financing, structured on the Islamic financing mode of Ijarah.

products.name: Meezan Easy Home
products.summary: Islamic home finance structured on Diminishing Musharakah, in which the customer and the bank take joint ownership of the property and ownership is gradually transferred to the customer.
